How to assemble clean hearing binders from 15 messy source files:

1. Drag in grievance records, timecards, doctor notes & CBA clauses
2. Visual thumbnail drag-and-drop reordering & page rotation
3. Auto-normalize page dimensions to standard 8.5x11 inch format
4. Export one single, cohesive hearing binder PDF

Tested on files up to 250MB locally in your browser memory:

https://pdftools.unionlawlibrary.com/?tool=merge&utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=packet_binder_merger
